description: This PHP file is a bootstrap script for initializing the Doctrine ORM in the OrangeHRM application. It loads dependencies via autoload, attempts to establish a database connection through Doctrine::getEntityManager(), and handles exceptions if the configuration is missing.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: Handler class for Doctrine ORM functionality within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: Doctrine::getEntityManager
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Doctrine Entity Manager object.
